note: Category IDs with our own one-line paraphrase.

items.title: Policies, processes and practices
items.summary: Organization-wide AI risk policies and practices are in place and transparent.

items.title: Accountability structures
items.summary: Right teams are assigned responsibility, empowered and trained.

items.title: Workforce diversity and inclusion
items.summary: Diverse, inclusive teams take part in AI risk work.

items.title: Risk-aware culture
items.summary: Teams consider and communicate AI risk.

items.title: Engagement with external AI actors
items.summary: Feedback from external actors is gathered and used.

items.title: Third-party risk policies
items.summary: Policies cover risks from third-party software, data and supply chain.

items.title: Context established
items.summary: Context and intended purpose of the AI system are understood.

items.title: System categorization
items.summary: The system's tasks, methods and limits are categorized.

items.title: Capabilities, benefits and costs
items.summary: Capabilities, goals, benefits and costs are understood.

items.title: Component risk mapping
items.summary: Risks are mapped for all components, including third-party data and software.

items.title: Impact characterization
items.summary: Impacts on individuals, groups, society are characterized.

items.title: Methods and metrics
items.summary: Suitable measurement methods and metrics are chosen and applied.

items.title: Trustworthiness evaluation
items.summary: Systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.

items.title: Risk tracking over time
items.summary: Mechanisms track identified risks over time.

items.title: Measurement feedback
items.summary: Feedback on measurement efficacy is gathered.

items.title: Risk prioritization and response
items.summary: Mapped and measured risks are prioritized and treated.

items.title: Benefit maximization, harm minimization
items.summary: Strategies maximize benefits and reduce negative impacts.

items.title: Third-party risk management
items.summary: Risks from third-party entities are managed.

items.title: Response, recovery and communication
items.summary: Treatment, response, recovery and communication plans are documented and monitored.
